title: Apply Application Size and Delivery Analysis
prompt: Create a device-specific size report, remove one verified source of bloat and add a release budget with owned exceptions.
successCriteria: The user or release outcome, environment, version, and acceptance threshold are explicit.
Evidence connects the observed cost or failure to the responsible mechanism.
Correctness, failure recovery, regression protection, ownership, and rollout decisions are documented.
hints: Reduce the problem to one representative journey before widening the test matrix.
Record raw evidence and compare one controlled change rather than relying on intuition.

starterCode.code:
./gradlew :app:bundleRelease
# Inspect AAB and generated device APK set; attribute DEX, resources, assets and native libs.

solutionOutline: Define the contract and capture a representative baseline or failure reproduction.
Implement the smallest safe change, verify success and failure paths, then add an owned regression guard.
verification: Repeat the scenario under controlled conditions and retain the evidence with version context.
Exercise one adverse path and confirm the documented recovery or roll-forward action.
